requirements.requirement: Reusable Species Definition, lineage/variant, Form Definition, biological trait/Ability Definition, Character selection, current body/form state and provenance remain distinguishable semantic layers.
Definition inspection/comparison never creates Character selection, current Form state or runtime mutation and never rewrites source content.
Source fact, source absence/source-unspecified, conflict, inference/recommendation, Character state and runtime state remain distinguishable; unknown is not a human default.
Culture, society, belief, philosophy, profession and learned behavior remain separate from immutable biology unless explicit source/rule evidence establishes a biological mechanism.
Species eligibility, Species Perk labeling and mixed-dataset membership do not by themselves prove physiology or biology ownership.
The governed 2,203-row mixed Ability surface remains 260 Species Perks, 539 Innate Abilities and 1,404 Elementalist rows with zero automatic biology promotion.
Character Species/Form selection stores stable references, accepted grants, rules profile and pack-lock evidence through F004 without editing reusable Definitions.
Lineage/subspecies/variant relationships require explicit source-backed relationship evidence; same-name, shared-document or visual similarity cannot create them.
Correction/respec preserves attributable before/after state and append-only history and revalidates selection/grants/compatibility before commit.
Reusable Form Definition remains distinct from a Character's current active Form; inspection never activates a Form.
Transformation execution routes through F006/F007 or the owning Ability workflow and commits accepted form-state outcome and governed cost atomically.
The 60 detailed and 57 pricing-only Shapeshifter rows retain zero automatic merges by name, tier, position, order or similarity.
Known/acquired Adaptations remain separate from current active Adaptation slots/state, and acquisition/swap validates sourced costs, slots, cooldowns and incompatibilities.
Environment-linked learned or contextual Abilities do not become biological Adaptations without explicit Species/Form/innate/body evidence or an owning transformation contract.
Campaign/Scene and world environment authoring remain owned by PPIA-08/PPIA-12; current environment may constrain physiology without rewriting Species source truth.
Innate Ability/Species Perk execution preserves Ability Definition identity and biology-ownership classification; execution never reclassifies an Ability as physiological.
Authoritative Ability execution validates actor, eligibility, target/context and governed Resource cost and commits result/cost atomically.
Unauthorized menus, failures, diagnostics and AI context cannot disclose hidden Forms, triggers, innate capabilities or vulnerabilities.
Morphology/body-plan/anatomy fields represent sourced facts where available and never silently synthesize normal-human anatomy from source absence.
Senses, breathing, movement modes, environment tolerances, metabolism and lifespan remain sourced/unknown-aware physiology fields; current environment constraints do not rewrite source physiology.
Appearance prose and biological mechanics remain distinguishable, while PPIA-06 receives source-backed biological constraints/visible markers without PPIA-05 absorbing visual appearance authoring.
Biological/Form/host compatibility requires explicit source/rule evidence; absence of an incompatibility statement is not universal compatibility.
Unknown compatibility remains unknown and routes to the owning workflow's governed block/warn policy rather than silently enabling a selection or modification.
Hidden weaknesses/incompatibilities are filtered before compare targets, warnings, counts, failures, diagnostics and AI context.
Kola-Ha source-backed Forms/modifications are biological modification semantics and are not generic equipment by default.
Biological modification requires explicit authority, host compatibility evidence, sourced temporary/permanent rules, expected version, idempotency and append-only history.
PPIA-03 Asset/cybernetic semantics apply only where source/rules explicitly model an Asset or installed object; biological Forms are not relabeled as inventory for UI reuse.
Playable Creature conversion preserves source Creature, playable Species/Form draft and Character instance as separate identities with attributable retained/normalized/excluded/unlocked facts.
Converted linked Abilities remain stable references rather than copied/forked mechanics, and F004 revalidates Character selection/grants.
PPIA-05 routes rather than absorbs PPIA-02 Creature identity/ecology, PPIA-03 explicit Asset relations, PPIA-06 appearance, PPIA-08 environments, PPIA-11 balance and PPIA-12 world/culture authoring.
Authorization/filtering precede Species/Form existence, hidden Forms/weaknesses, counts, facets, compares, warnings, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI/service context.
Campaign reveal/hide is audience-scoped, unknown-to-Player is not false-in-source, and GM authority remains Campaign-scoped rather than universal access.
Service/AI and Assistant GM actors receive minimum authorized projections and cannot independently choose Species/Form, transform, reveal, respec, bioengineer, classify or promote content.
Every authoritative Species/Form/biology mutation is expected-version checked and idempotent or governed by an equivalent concurrency contract.
Ambiguous network outcomes query operation status using the original operation ID before retry and reuse the same idempotency identity.

Reconnect reauthorizes Character/Campaign role, pack/rules profile, visible Forms/weaknesses, current body/form state and versions; cached hidden/revoked state cannot restore authority and broad offline authoritative mutation is forbidden.
Every core Species/Form/Biology workflow has keyboard, touch and screen-reader-equivalent operation; color, drag, hover, silhouette, body-diagram pointing or animation is never the only path.
Morphology/body-plan and appearance-linked biological facts have textual semantic equivalents and high-zoom/reflow preserves identity, prerequisites, compatibility and current-state meaning.
Transformation, Adaptation, selection and recovery results are announced as semantic state changes; reduced-motion users do not depend on animation to understand authoritative outcomes.
Authorized source/conflict/recommendation review exposes provenance without silently choosing a winner or mutating raw PDF/CSV source.
All 20 reference cases remain acceptance fixtures, synthetic QA creates zero canonical synthetic records, and unresolved identity/classification/compatibility remains explicit.
PPIA-05 completion cannot activate STAGE-A-A2, application runtime, release/deployment/tester access/paid services/credentials or unsupported canonical promotion; downstream domains retain ownership.
